name: Execute a SQL query
query:
WITH updated_user AS (
  UPDATE users
  SET
    name = '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.name || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    email = '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.email || "")).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    sector_id = NULLIF('{{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.sectorId || "" }}', '')::uuid,
    active = {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === false || $("Webhook").item.json.body.active === 'false' ? 'FALSE' : 'TRUE' }},
    is_master = {{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === true || $("Webhook").item.json.body.isMaster === 'true' ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE' }},
    password_hash = CASE
      WHEN NULLIF('{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.passwordHash || $("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}', '') IS NOT NULL
      THEN crypt(
        '{{ String(($("Webhook").item.json.body.passwordHash || $("Webhook").item.json.body.password || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
        gen_salt('bf', 10)
      )
      ELSE password_hash
    END,
    updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = '{{ $("Webhook").item.json.body.id }}'::uuid
  RETURNING id
),
deleted_permissions AS (
  DELETE FROM user_permissions
  WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM updated_user)
  RETURNING user_id
)
SELECT u.id
FROM updated_user u
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deleted_permissions) >= 0;

name: Salvar permissões
query:
WITH inserted_permissions AS (
  INSERT INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission_id)
  SELECT DISTINCT
    '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid,
    p.id
  FROM permissions p
  WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    AND p.code IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_array_elements_text(
        '{{ JSON.stringify($("Webhook").item.json.body.permissions || []) }}'::jsonb
      )
    )
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING permission_id
)
SELECT
  u.id,
  u.name,
  u.email,
  u.sector_id AS "sectorId",
  s.name AS "sectorName",
  u.active,
  u.is_master AS "isMaster",
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(p.code ORDER BY p.code)
      FROM inserted_permissions ip
      JOIN permissions p ON p.id = ip.permission_id
      WHERE p.code <> 'gerenciar_tags'
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS permissions,
  u.created_at AS "createdAt",
  u.updated_at AS "updatedAt"
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN sectors s ON s.id = u.sector_id
WHERE u.id = '{{ $json.id }}'::uuid;
